items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee does not mention John Cashmere in their own turns. The interviewer mentions 'John Cashmere' and describes him as a pioneer whose band it was, but the interviewee's response focuses on George Lewis and does not confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Cashmere.
